data.body: Phase C ESCALATED investigation complete. Convergence_score=2; Empirical veto_issued=false. ROOT_CAUSE: Phase F Step 18 has no positive-coverage trailer invariant; merge-story-branch.sh silently no-ops when story tip == session tip in worktree-isolation mode (empirically reproduced — same-tip merge produces zero commits, zero trailers); completion-verifier has zero DSO-Story-Merge awareness. Recommended fix: F2 (new verify-story-merge-trailer.sh) + F3 (merge-story-branch.sh --allow-empty no-diff path) + F4 (completion-verifier trailer assertion) + F5 fixture; F1 reframed as positive invariant; F6 ci.yml warning deferable.
